snippet.title: ITEM RAIN and MORE! Wack Track Pack v5 Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Item Rain finally comes to WTP, along with some surprising new playable characters. Try out Wack Track Pack and play online on console or Dolphin with no NAND required!

Comment if you found inspector gadget.

Join our Discord server for updates and to know when people are playing: https://discord.com/invite/XB6YmGhyNA

Get Wack Track Pack: https://wiki.tockdom.com/wiki/Grillin%27s_Wack_Track_Pack
HOW TO DOWNLOAD WTP: https://youtu.be/dcQv1O5IJ4k

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Credits:
Item Rain in Pulsar brought to you by the one and only @ZachPL__ 
Custom Characters featured made by Porko, UltraWario, and delinquenst. Go check out their work on the wiiki!
Big thanks to our pal Seamus for editing this trailer!
